# Get-AvmCatalogTelemetryPrefix

## Synopsis

Read current and historical telemetry prefixes from the public AVM catalog.

## Description

Uses the raw HTTPS catalog by default. An explicit local JSON path is
accepted for offline review. If the catalog cannot be read or parsed,
warns and returns no prefixes; callers must also check local metadata.

## Syntax

```powershell
Get-AvmCatalogTelemetryPrefix [-CatalogUri <string>] [-ExcludeBicepModulePath <string>] [-SkipModuleVersionCheck] [<CommonParameters>]

Get-AvmCatalogTelemetryPrefix -Catalog <IDictionary> [-ExcludeBicepModulePath <string>] [-SkipModuleVersionCheck] [<CommonParameters>]
```
